_note: tenders-run-on-the-tender-case-type task 3.1 (openspec/changes/tenders-run-on-the-tender-case-type): a case type that runs the tender chain says so as configuration (decision 182), and the case page places its lots, questions and answers, bids, evaluation and award by that flag rather than by the case type's name. The aanbesteding package sets it. caseType moves to 1.50.0 (1.49.0 is inspection-checklist) so an existing instance re-imports the schema. A fragment per ADR-037.

tenderChain.title: Runs the tender chain
tenderChain.description: Whether a case of this type is a tender: its case page shows the lots as sub-cases, the questions and published answers, the bids, the evaluation ranked by the scoring formula and the award.
